text: Given valid credentials and no filters, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then it returns the standard list envelope and each item has id, first_name, last_name, email, role_name, my_glue and last_sign_in_at.
Given name, email and role_name are passed, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then they are forwarded as filter[name], filter[email] and filter[role_name] on the GET /users request.

Given a sort value such as "-created_at", When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then the sort query parameter is forwarded unchanged to IT Glue (no local validation, matching every other list tool).

Given the account has more users than fit on one page, When the caller walks the result with next_offset, Then every user is returned exactly once and a page IT Glue cuts short continues exactly where it stopped.
notes: Covered by adding ("itglue_list_account_users", "/users", {}) to the shared LISTS table in tests/test_paging_offset.py; the parametrized test id's exact suffix depends on LISTS position at implementation time.

text: Given the X-ITGlue-API-Key header is missing, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "not_configured", ...}} rather than raising.
notes: Already covered generically via the shared run() path (tested today against get_organization); no per-tool duplicate is required since the new tool goes through the same run() helper unmodified. Add a one-line parametrize entry for itglue_list_account_users if the dev leg wants an explicit per-tool assertion.

text: Given IT Glue returns 429 then 200, When itglue_list_account_users is called, Then it retries once honouring Retry-After and returns the successful envelope; given IT Glue returns 403, Then it returns {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false}}.
notes: Error-code mapping and retry/backoff are exercised generically today against other tools (get_organization / itglue_health_check) through the shared ITGlueClient.request() path; the new tool reuses that path unmodified. Add a dedicated GET /users case if the dev leg wants explicit per-tool coverage.

text: Given tools/list is queried, When itglue_list_account_users is registered, Then it is present with readOnlyHint true, has no agent_id parameter, is listed in README's Tools table, and no existing tool loses a name or parameter.
notes: Requires adding an itglue_list_account_users entry to tests/fixtures/tools_baseline.json in the same change.
